verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a company-incorporation and formation service: Delaware entity formation, EIN and 83(b) filings, legal documents, and banking setup. User-defined scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows is outside the axis of this product type. The only recurring-adjacent evidence is a community mention of filing reminders, which are vendor compliance notifications rather than a user-schedulable automation capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
